settings.label: Personal access token
settings.meaning: Reads the account's forms and responses, and manages their webhooks.
settings.whereToFind: Account › Personal tokens › Generate a new token, with the forms:read, responses:read, webhooks:read and webhooks:write scopes. Typeform has no test mode: use a separate form for test.

settings.label: Webhook secret
settings.meaning: Checks that a webhook came from Typeform. You choose it, and it's sent to Typeform when the webhook is made.
settings.whereToFind: Any long random string of your own: webhooks.put sends it to Typeform.

settings.label: API address
settings.meaning: Where the account's data lives. Only for accounts in Typeform's EU data center.
settings.whereToFind: https://api.eu.typeform.com for an EU account; leave it unset otherwise.

operations.name: forms.list
operations.purpose: Lists the account's forms, a page at a time, optionally matching a search.

operations.name: forms.get
operations.purpose: Reads one form: its fields, with each field's ref, and its hidden fields.

operations.name: responses.list
operations.purpose: Lists a form's responses, newest first, a page at a time.

operations.name: webhooks.put
operations.purpose: Creates or updates the form's webhook with this tag, signed with the webhook secret.

operations.name: webhooks.delete
operations.purpose: Deletes the form's webhook with this tag.

signature.description: The header is sha256= followed by the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, keyed with the webhook's secret.
